name: Subtitle Extract Plus
description: Fork of Subtitle Extract with per-language and forced/non-forced track selection, configurable default-language preference, extraction caching, and on-add extraction. Saves subtitles next to the media file using Jellyfin's external subtitle naming convention.
overview: Extracts embedded subtitles with per-language and forced-track filtering.

versions.changelog: 5.0.0.0: configurable default-language preference with fallback chain; extraction cache; on-add extraction; empty forced-track resilience; fixed config-save enum serialization; fixed extraction being skipped when library exposes no subtitle streams; Jellyfin 12 IPluginServiceRegistrator support.
4.0.0.0: per-language and forced/non-forced track selection; save subtitles next to media files using Jellyfin's external subtitle naming convention.
